facts.fact: Yes: under the SMILE scheme the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment awards scholarships to transgender students in Class IX and above (pre-matric and post-matric)
facts.quote: awarded by the Ministry to Transgender students studying in classes IX and above (Prematric & Postmatric stage)

facts.fact: The student must have a Transgender Certificate issued through the National Portal for Transgender Persons
facts.quote: (b)The student should have a Transgender Certificate issued through the National Portal for Transgender person of the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment.

facts.fact: Fresh and renewal applications are made on the National Portal for Transgender Persons with the login used for the transgender certificate and ID card
facts.quote: (a)The scholarship can be availed by registering/applying on the National Portal for Transgender Person through a login ID and Password used to issue the Transgender Certificate & Identity card.

behaviour: Names the MoSJE scholarship for transgender students under SMILE as published on socialjustice.gov.in, with citation, and says where to apply.
fail_if: Says no scholarship exists for transgender students, or invents amounts or eligibility not in the official guidelines.
summary: SMILE guidelines (socialjustice.gov.in): scholarships for transgender students from Class IX, need a TG certificate, apply on the National Portal for Transgender Persons (not NSP).
